collections.title: Amakusanyirizo Yatoranyijwe <accent>Ku Ngano.</accent>
collections.intro: Ingano ni ingenzi. Reba amakusanyirizo yacu yateguwe neza ashyizwe mu byiciro by'ingano kugira ngo ubone amakaro nyayo ahuza n'ibisabwa n'ubwiza bw'umushinga wawe.

visualizer.body: Koresha igikoresho cyacu cya 3D gishingiye kuri AI kugira ngo urebe uko aya makaro agaragara mu cyumba mbere yo kugura.

notFound.title: Igicuruzwa nticyabonetse

compare.title: Igereranya rihanukiriye
compare.intro: Shyira amakaro agera kuri {{max}} hamwe maze ugereranye ibiranga, ubuso bipfuka n'aho akwiriye mbere yo guhitamo. Itandukaniro riragaragazwa.
compare.pickPrompt: Hitamo nibura ikaro rimwe ku rutonde kugira ngo utangire kugereranya.
compare.searchPlaceholder: Shakisha ku izina, SKU cyangwa ingano…

calculator.title: Icyumba cyawe gikeneye ibikoresho bingana iki?
calculator.intro: Andika ingero z'icyumba cyawe (cyangwa ubuso bwose) maze tuzabara umubare ukenewe, harimo n'ubwo bwaka, tugabanye hagati y'ibyo dushobora kohereza tuvanye mu bubiko buriho n'ibyo byakwiye kuboneka ukundi.
calculator.knowTotalAreaHint: Simbuka uburebure × ubugari maze wandike m² mu buryo butaziguye.
calculator.useTotalAreaAria: Andika ubuso bwose aho kwandika ingero
calculator.wastageHint: {{percent}}% birasabwa ku miterere igororotse; emera 15% ku miterere y'umurongo ukiraramye cyangwa herringbone.
calculator.searchTilesPlaceholder: Shakisha ku izina, ikusanyirizo cyangwa ingano…
calculator.fullyAvailable: Ibyo ukeneye byose birahari — bishobora koherezwa bitangira igihe ifatabuguzi ryemejwe.
calculator.partiallyAvailable: Igice cy'iri tumizo cyaturuka mu itsinda rikurikira. Itsinda ryacu ry'ububiko rizakwemeza igihe bizatwara mbere yo kwishyura.

visualizer.empty: Nta byumba byashyiriweho igaragaza. Garuka mukanya.
visualizer.noTilesInCollection: Nta makaro ari muri iri kusanyirizo.

saveDialog.title: Bika igishushanyo
saveDialog.description: Bika iki cyumba kuri konti yawe, cyangwa ugisangize itsinda ryacu ry'abagurisha kugira ngo bagihindure ifatabuguzi rifite umubare nyawo ukeneye.
saveDialog.shareHint: Bashobora kubihindura ifatabuguzi rifite umubare nyawo.

toast.signInToSave: Fungura konti y'ubuntu cyangwa winjire kugira ngo ubike igishushanyo cyawe.

toast.roomNotReadyBody: Tegereza icyumba kirangize gutangira, hanyuma ongera ugerageze.
toast.savedShared: Cyabitswe kuri konti yawe kandi gisangijwe itsinda ry'abagurisha.

chatbot.title: Umufasha wa AI mu Gushushanya
chatbot.welcome: Murakaza neza kuri Magnificat Smart Space! Ndi Umufasha wawe wa AI mu Gushushanya. Reka dusobanure ibyo ukeneye kugira ngo nkugezeho inama nziza — ngiye kubaza ibibazo bike byihuse mbere yo gutangira.
chatbot.errorReply: Ihangane, hari ikitagenze neza iwacu — ongera ugerageze.
chatbot.savedNote: Umushinga wawe ubitswe kuri konti yawe.
chatbot.signInNote: Injira kugira ngo ubike imishinga yawe y'igishushanyo.

feedback.acceptedBody: Twishimiye ko ibi byatoranyijwe byakubereye — ongera icyo wakunze mu gatebo cyangwa urebe ibisobanuro byuzuye haruguru igihe cyose uteguye.
feedback.rejectedBody: Byanditswe — mbwira byinshi ku byo ushaka (ibara, ingano, ingengo y'imari, icyo ari cyo cyose) maze ngerageze indi nzira.

chatbot.notePlaceholder: Ongeraho inyandiko ku cyumba cyawe (si itegeko)…
chatbot.inputHint: Kanda Enter wohereze · Shift + Enter kugira ngo utangire umurongo mushya · Omeka ifoto y'icyumba kugira ngo urebe ikaro ku butaka bwacyo

followUps.livingRoom: Nkeneye amabuye manini y'icyiciro cyo hejuru ku cyumba kinini cyo kwakiriramo.
followUps.bathroom: Ni amakaro ki akwiriye ubwiherero — ku butaka no ku nkuta?
followUps.kitchen: Ni amakaro ki meza ku gikoni cya kijyambere?

toast.connectionBody: Reba umurongo wawe hanyuma wongere ugerageze.
toast.feedbackFailedBody: Ongera ugerageze — ntabwo bizahindura ibigaragara hano.

logout.title: Gusohoka?
logout.description: Uzasabwa kongera kwinjira kugira ngo ugere kuri konti yawe.

profile.heading: Umwirondoro Bwite
profile.emailNote: Ifitanye isano no kwinjira — ntishobora guhindurirwa hano.
profile.phoneNote: Yemejwe mu kwiyandikisha — vugana n'umuyobozi kugira ngo uyihindure.

deleteAccount.heading: Gusiba Konti
deleteAccount.body: Gufunga konti yawe biyihagarika kandi biyisohora ku bikoresho byose. Amateka y'amatumizo n'ay'ubwishyu abikwa, ntayo isibwa.
deleteAccount.dialogDescription: Iki gikorwa ntikigarurwa. Konti yawe izahagarikwa kandi buri gikorwa cyose gizasohorwa.

favorites.subtitle: Kurikirana kandi ucunge ibicuruzwa wabitse.
favorites.emptyBody: Bika ibicuruzwa ukunda kugira ngo ubisange hano.

designs.title: Ibishushanyo byabitswe
designs.subtitle: Ibyumba washushanyije mu igaragaza rya 3D. Sangiza itsinda ry'abagurisha igihe ubibika maze bagihindure ifatabuguzi rifite umubare nyawo ukeneye.
designs.emptyBody: Gerageza amakaro ku cyumba nyakuri mu igaragaza rya 3D, hanyuma ubike ibyo ukunze kugira ngo ubigarukeho nyuma.

orders.title: Amatumizo yanjye
orders.subtitle: Kurikirana kandi ucunge amatumizo yawe ashize y'ibikoresho by'ubwubatsi.
orders.noneForStatus: Nta matumizo aboneka kuri iyi mimerere.

orderDetail.notFoundBody: Iri tumizo ntiribaho, cyangwa si iryawe.
orderDetail.heading: Itumizo #{{number}}
orderDetail.waitlistedTitle: Ku rutonde rw'ategereje — igice cy'iri tumizo nticyari mu bubiko ubu
orderDetail.waitlistedBody: Twemeye iri tumizo; nta gikorwa gisabwa kuri wowe ubu. Tuzakwandikira imeri igihe ububiko buzahagije, hanyuma uzagira akanya gato ko kurangiza ubwishyu.

cart.waitlistedTitle: Itumizo ryemewe — riri ku rutonde rw'ategereje ububiko
cart.submittedBody: Urakoze — itumizo ryawe ryoherejwe ku itsinda ryacu ry'ububiko kugira ngo barirebe. Tuzategura ifatabuguzi ryuzuye, harimo amafaranga y'ubwikorezi n'amakuru y'ubwishyu, hanyuma tukumenyeshe hano igihe biteguye.
cart.waitlistedBody: Urakoze — twemeye itumizo ryawe, ariko igice cyaryo nticyari mu bubiko ubu. Nta gikorwa gisabwa kuri wowe ubu: tuzakwandikira imeri igihe ububiko buzahagije, hanyuma uzagira akanya gato ko kurangiza ubwishyu.
cart.clearCartDescription: Ibi bikuraho buri kintu cyose mu byo watoranyije. Ntibigarurwa.
cart.emptyBody: Reba ikusanyirizo ryacu maze wongereho amakaro akwiriye umushinga wawe ukurikira.
cart.shortageBody: Gushyira itumizo bishobora gushyira iki gice ku rutonde rw'ategereje kugeza ububiko bwiyongereye — cyangwa, niba biruta ibyo dufite byose, tuzafungura ikiganiro n'itsinda ryacu ry'ububiko hepfo. Ushobora kandi kugabanya ingano.
cart.shortagesOne: Ikintu kimwe kirenga ibiboneka ubu — niba bishobora gukurwa mu bubiko buriho, tuzabyemera maze dushyire icyo gice ku rutonde rw'ategereje; bitaba ibyo tuzafungura ikiganiro n'itsinda ryacu ry'ububiko hepfo.
cart.shortagesMany: Ibintu {{count}} birenga ibiboneka ubu — niba bishobora gukurwa mu bubiko buriho, tuzabyemera maze dushyire icyo gice ku rutonde rw'ategereje; bitaba ibyo tuzafungura ikiganiro n'itsinda ryacu ry'ububiko hepfo.
cart.toastCantPlaceBody: Igice cy'agatebo kawe kirenga ibyo dufite mu bubiko — twatangiye ikiganiro n'itsinda ryacu ry'ububiko hepfo.
cart.toastWaitlistedTitle: Itumizo ryemewe — riri ku rutonde rw'ategereje ububiko
cart.toastSubmittedBody: Ryoherejwe ku itsinda ryacu ry'ububiko kugira ngo barirebe. Uzarisanga muri Amatumizo Yanjye rimaze kwemezwa.
cart.toastWaitlistedBody: Igice cyaryo nticyari mu bubiko ubu. Tuzakwandikira imeri igihe kizabonekera.

deliveryDialog.title: Amakuru yo gutanga
deliveryDialog.description: Tubwire aho n'igihe byatangirwa. Aya makuru ashyirwa ku itumizo ryawe kugira ngo itsinda ry'ububiko rikore ifatabuguzi.
deliveryDialog.notesPlaceholder: Amabwiriza yo kwinjira, uwo bahamagara ku rubuga, n'ibindi.
deliveryDialog.defaultSuccess: Yashyizwe ku itumizo ryawe kugira ngo itsinda ry'ububiko rirebe.

deliveryCard.title: Amakuru yo Gutanga
deliveryCard.noneLocked: Nta makuru yo gutanga yashyizweho mbere y'uko ifatabuguzi ryoherezwa.
deliveryCard.prompt: Ongeraho aderesi yawe yo gutangira n'uwo bavugana kugira ngo itsinda ry'ububiko rikore ifatabuguzi rinyuze.

quotationCard.title: Ifatabuguzi
quotationCard.awaitingBody: Itsinda ryacu ry'ububiko rirasuzuma itumizo ryawe. Rimaze kuba ryiteguye, tuzakoherereza ifatabuguzi ryuzuye hano, harimo amafaranga y'ubwikorezi n'amakuru y'ubwishyu.
quotationCard.dialogDescription: Igiteranyo cyishyurwa {{total}} — amakuru ya MoMo n'aya banki ari ku nyandiko hepfo.
quotationCard.paymentSubmitted: Ubwishyu bwoherejwe — butegereje kwemezwa n'itsinda ryacu.
quotationCard.toastPaidBody: Itsinda ryacu rizabusuzuma maze ryemeze itumizo ryawe vuba.

orderNegotiation.shortageTitle: Igice cy'iri tumizo gikeneye ikiganiro n'itsinda ryacu ry'ububiko
orderNegotiation.shortageMany: Ibintu {{count}} birenga ibiboneka mu bubiko ubu.
orderNegotiation.heading: Ganira n'itsinda ryacu ry'ububiko

orderSupport.editDescription: Itumizo rimaze koherezwa ntirishobora guhindurirwa hano, kugira ngo ifatabuguzi n'igabana ry'ububiko bigume ari ukuri. Itsinda ryacu ry'ubufasha ku bakiriya rishobora kugukorera iyo mpinduka.
orderSupport.stuckDescription: Niba iri tumizo risa n'irihagaze cyangwa utarasubizwa, itsinda ryacu ry'ubufasha ku bakiriya rishobora kureba uko rihagaze ku itsinda ry'ububiko maze rigukurikirane ku giti cyawe.
orderSupport.responseNote: Itsinda ryacu risubiza mu isaha imwe y'akazi.

cartNegotiation.emptyOne: {{name}}: {{area}} m² yose yasabwe ntiboneka ubu. Ohereza ubutumwa hepfo kugira ngo ugere ku itsinda ryacu ry'ububiko.
